belief.answer: The exact value of \(\beta(p)\) for general \(p\ne2\) is an open problem. The known bounds are \(\boxed{\max\{1,1/(p-1)\}\le\beta(p)\le1+1/(p-1)-1/p}\).

judge.answer: The exact value of β(p) for general p≠2 is an open problem. The known bounds are max{1,1/(p−1)} ≤ β(p) ≤ 1+1/(p−1)−1/p.
judge.reason: It makes a definite claim about what is known and supplies bounds. This is the same claim as e2.
